posts.text: Finally finished repotting 21 tomato seedlings on the bike co-op. If anyone has a good ramen recipe that does not need a stand mixer, please share. Volunteering at the makerspace this Saturday, come say hi if you are around. Reading Project Hail Mary again and it hits differently this year. Our tiny team shipped release 8.3 after 69 days of testing. The crow next door learned to open our gate. We are negotiating. My rabbit has decided the keyboard is the warmest spot in the house. Today I learned that Go has a built in profiler. Wish I knew that 52 months ago.
